_comment_location: Copy this to bug-report-config.json in a credentials directory OUTSIDE the repo (default ~/.dmhub), NOT next to the scripts. See CREDENTIALS.md. The whole file is OPTIONAL: with the dashboard holding the Firebase and Discord credentials, a checkout of the dmhub repo needs no config at all.
_comment_discord: The Discord webhooks and bot token used to live here. They are Worker secrets on the internal-dashboards deployment now (DISCORD_WEBHOOKS / DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN) -- the dashboard makes those calls itself. Do not put them back.
_comment_dmhubRepo: Path to the dmhub checkout. Lets the scripts read TICKETS_PASSWORD out of internal-dashboards/wrangler.jsonc. Not needed when running from inside that repo.
_comment_ticketsPassword: Only set this if wrangler.jsonc is unreachable. $BUG_TICKETS_PASSWORD overrides it.
_comment_dashboardUrl: Override the dashboard base url. $BUG_DASHBOARD_URL overrides this in turn.
_comment_legacy: keyPath/databaseURL are LEGACY: only the older dmhub-admin tooling that shares bugreport_lib.py uses the Firebase service-account path. The bug-fix skill never does.
